input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The fee provisions contain no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction, so there is no MFN obligation burdening us. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement
input.rationale: Section 19 is a no-hire (not merely a non-solicit) that on its face covers any employee of the other party and its affiliates, with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out — walk-away territory under our playbook. We proposed narrowing it to solicitation of personnel directly involved in the services and adding the standard carve-outs; the mutual term-plus-12-months duration is acceptable.
